name: Sylius
title: Sylius SvelteKit Storefront — Svelte Commerce Connector
description: Svelte Commerce on Sylius’s shop API: 24 of 43 services wired, with cart, checkout and sign-in; wishlist, vendors and CMS pages are gaps. Setup and fixes.
lede: Solid core coverage: cart, checkout and sign-in are wired against Sylius’s shop API. Sylius picks the channel from the request’s host, so the URL you give the connector decides which channel the storefront sells from.
verdict: Cart, checkout and sign-in are wired; wishlist, vendors and CMS pages are not.

quickStart.text: one connector at a time: remove the two the storefront ships with, add this one
point it at your Sylius channel

env.name: PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_URL
env.note: Your Sylius URL. Sylius picks the channel from this URL’s host — there is no channel header or parameter. Boot fails, naming this variable, if it is missing.

env.name: PUBLIC_SYLIUS_LOCALE_CODE
env.note: Such as `de_DE`, sent as `Accept-Language`. Sylius falls back to the channel’s default locale.

env.name: PUBLIC_SYLIUS_STORE_ID
env.note: Treated as the channel code, and used only to read that channel’s details.

env.name: PUBLIC_SYLIUS_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.note: Sent as a bearer token when set.

env.name: PUBLIC_CONNECTOR
env.note: Only when more than one connector is installed: `@misiki/sylius-connector` names the one this build runs on.

envNote: `init.ts` hands the connector every `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_*` variable that is set, camel-cased. The guide also lists `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_CHANNEL_ID`, which cannot work against a stock install — the channel comes from the host — and `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_KEY`, `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_SECRET` and `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_ACCESS_KEY`, which the connector’s source does not read.
backendSettings: Point `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_URL` at the hostname of the channel you want to sell from: Sylius resolves the channel from the request’s host.
howItWorks: The connector speaks Sylius’s shop API. The channel is whichever one Sylius matches to the host of `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_URL`; the locale travels as `Accept-Language`. The API documentation URL its authors were given was dead, so it was written from Sylius’s own source instead.

faq.q: Can I run a Sylius store on Svelte Commerce today?
faq.a: Cart, checkout and sign-in are wired; wishlist, vendors and CMS pages are not. Like every connector, it has not been run against a live production Sylius store.

faq.q: How do I switch Svelte Commerce to Sylius?
faq.a: Remove the connectors the storefront ships with, install `@misiki/sylius-connector`, set `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_URL` in `.env` and start the dev server. `vite.config.ts` resolves whichever connector is installed, so no file in the storefront changes.

faq.q: How does Svelte Commerce pick a Sylius channel?
faq.a: By host. Sylius resolves the channel from the host of the request, so point `PUBLIC_SYLIUS_API_URL` at the channel’s hostname. There is no channel header or parameter to set instead.

api.surface: The connector calls the Sylius 2.1 shop API, a REST API in Hydra JSON-LD under `/api/v2/shop`, with `Accept: application/ld+json` on every request.
api.auth: A shopper signs in with `POST /api/v2/shop/customers/token`, and the returned JWT goes out as `Authorization: Bearer`; the `customer` IRI from that response is kept in memory, `localStorage` and a cookie, because Sylius has no `/customers/me`, and with no refresh token in Sylius core a 401 means signing in again.

calls.what: `GET /api/v2/shop/products` with `translations.name`, `taxon` (a taxon IRI), `page`, `itemsPerPage` and `order[...]`; a product page reads `GET /products-by-slug/{slug}`, then `/product-variants?product=<IRI>`, `/product-options` and `/product-option-values`

`POST /api/v2/shop/orders` with an empty object creates the cart; lines go through `POST`, `PATCH` and `DELETE /orders/{tokenValue}/items`, and a coupon through `PUT /orders/{tokenValue}` with `couponCode`
`GET /orders/{tokenValue}/payments/{id}/methods`, then `PATCH /orders/{tokenValue}/payments/{id}` with the method IRI, then `PATCH /orders/{tokenValue}/complete` with `notes`
`GET /api/v2/shop/orders` for the signed-in customer, `GET /orders/{tokenValue}` for one order, and `GET /orders/{tokenValue}/shipments/{id}` for tracking
`POST /customers/token` to sign in, `POST /customers` to register, `POST /customers/reset-password` and `PATCH /customers/reset-password/{token}` for a reset

rules: Collections come back as `hydra:member` with the total in `hydra:totalItems`, since Sylius sends no pagination headers, and the connector reads both the prefixed and the unprefixed keys.

Every `PATCH` is sent as `application/merge-patch+json`, which is the only type Sylius accepts on that verb, and line quantity, shipping method, payment method and checkout completion are all `PATCH` calls.

Sorting uses bracketed `order[field]` parameters, and the connector drops any field that is not on its list (`code`, `createdAt`, `price` and `translation.name` for products) because Sylius ignores an unknown sort without an error.
The shop API is stateless, so the cart’s only handle is the `tokenValue` in the body of `POST /orders`, which the connector stores and then replays as a path segment.
The connector leaves the `Authorization` header off the token route, because a stale bearer token there is checked first and the credentials never reach the sign-in.
